claims.text: Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters warned on Sunday that any renewed US military action would trigger continuous, effective, and painful attacks on US bases and interests across West Asia.
Iran warned regional countries supporting US military action that they would be considered participants in the conflict.
US Central Command stated that its forces had redirected 109 commercial vessels as of September 20 to enforce a naval blockade on Iranian ports.
US President Donald Trump said he was in a "deciding mode" on Iran and warned that "very big things" could happen.
US State Department warned Americans on Saturday of potential unforeseen escalation in the region.
UK Minister for Women and Equalities Bridget Phillipson said Donald Trump's war with Iran will make next month's UK budget more difficult.
UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham is expected to meet Donald Trump early next week at the UN General Assembly summit in New York.
Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei announced that Iran set seven conditions for starting negotiations with the US government.
Mohsen Rezaei stated Iran is considering whether to withdraw from the Non-Proliferation Treaty depending on US conduct.
US President Donald Trump cut short a weekend at Camp David to return unexpectedly to the White House on Saturday.
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman called President Trump twice on Thursday urging him to launch strikes against the Houthis.
Saudi Arabia confirmed that Yemen's Houthi rebels attempted to attack Riyadh with a ballistic missile, which was intercepted at dawn on Saturday.
Houthi forces claimed to target sensitive sites in Riyadh and Saudi Aramco facilities in Yanbu.
Saudi Arabia said the Houthis attempted attacks on civilian infrastructure in Yanbu, Taif, Baysh, and Farasan.
Debris from an intercepted Houthi drone killed a Yemeni resident in Saudi Arabia on Thursday, marking the first reported civilian casualty in recent fighting.
Polls closed in Russia's first wartime parliamentary elections since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
Russia's Central Election Commission stated that turnout stood at 56.66 percent when polls closed.
Russia's Supreme Court removed the liberal Yabloko party, the only registered party openly criticizing the war, from the ballot last month.
Initial election results showed United Russia leading with 57.5 percent of the vote.
A facility at Moscow's oil refinery was damaged during a massive Ukrainian drone attack on Sunday.
Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said the unprecedented Ukrainian drone attack was intended to disrupt the elections.
Russia's Defence Ministry stated its forces shot down 1,110 Ukrainian drones across Russia, Crimea, and the Black Sea.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine used domestically produced Flamingo cruise missiles and Pelican weapons during the strike on Moscow.
Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin claimed more than 1,600 drones were shot down, including 450 aimed at Moscow.
Moscow regional Governor Andrei Vorobyev said at least two people were killed and 20 injured in the Moscow region during Ukrainian strikes.
An election official was killed in a drone attack on a bus in Russian-controlled Kherson, according to Russian state media.
US President Donald Trump signed a sanctions bill on Friday allowing 100 percent tariffs on major purchasers of Russian oil and gas.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz called his party's state election performance a disaster but insisted he will continue leading his government.
In Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, the CDU fell below the 5 percent threshold needed to stay in the state parliament, while the AfD placed first with a projected 38 percent.
In Berlin, Die Linke led state election projections with nearly 26 percent of the vote, ahead of the CDU at 20 percent.
AfD national co-leader Tino Chrupalla called on German Chancellor Friedrich Merz to resign following state election results.
Friedrich Merz took office as German Chancellor in May 2025 at the head of a coalition with the Social Democrats.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz abandoned a planned trip to New York for the UN General Assembly following state election losses.
In the September 6 state election in Saxony-Anhalt, the AfD defeated the CDU with 44 percent of the vote.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng began high-level economic talks in New York on Sunday.
The New York discussions at JPMorgan Chase's headquarters included US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer.
US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are scheduled to hold a summit meeting on Thursday at the White House.
Former US deputy secretary of state Kurt Campbell said Donald Trump is expected to announce intentions to meet Xi Jinping at the APEC summit in November and the G20 summit in December.
The US-China trade truce signed in Busan, South Korea, in November capped US tariffs on Chinese goods at about 20 percent and expires on November 10.
A senior US official stated that China's performance regarding the supply of critical minerals under last year's truce has not been up to par.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that the US is open to discussions with China on establishing artificial intelligence guardrails to avoid shared risks.
